senses.gloss:
बिभक्षयिषु बिभक्षयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr.
Desid. of rt. भक्ष्), wishing to eat, desirous of
eating.
—बिभक्षयिषु-दंष्ट्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
‘having teeth desirous of eating,’ hungry-mouthed.

बिभित्सा बिभित्सा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt.
भिद्), a desire to break through or destroy, wish to
pierce or penetrate (with acc., e. g. द्रोणानीकम्
बिभित्सा, the desire of breaking through the army of
Droṇa).

बिभित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of breaking through,
wishing to pierce or penetrate (with acc.).

बिभेदयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of Caus.),
desirous of severing, intending to divide or dis-
unite.

बिभ्रक्षु बिभ्रक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of
rt. भ्रज्ज्), wishing to roast or fry; desirous of scorch-
ing up, intending to scorch or parch; wishing to
destroy; (उस्), m. fire.

बिभ्रज्जिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to fry or parch;
(उस्), m. fire.
—बिभ्रज्जिषु-प्रख्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
resembling fire, (according to a Scholiast = अग्नि-
तुल्य.)

बिभ्रत् बिभ्रत्, अत्, अती, अत् (pres. part. of rt.
भृ, q. v.), bearing, carrying.

बिभ्रत्, अत्, अती, अत् (Pres. part. P.), bearing,
carrying.

बीभत्स बीभत्स, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Desid. of
rt. बाध्), loathsome, disgusting, nauseous, revolting,
detestable, hideous; loathing, detesting; envious;
cruel, mischievous; wicked; changed or estranged in
[]
mind; (अस्), m. disgust, abhorrence, detestation;
‘the disgusting,’ one of the eight Rasas; an epithet
of Arjuna, = बीभत्सु; (आ), f. (Ved.) loathing, ab-
horrence; disgust.
—बीभत्स-ता, f. loathsomeness,
detestableness.
—बीभत्सा-रस-निर्देश, अस्, m.,
N. of the 145th chapter of the Śārṅgadhara-pad-
dhati.

बीभत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, loathing, detesting, feeling
repugnance or abhorrence, disgusted, revolted; en-
vious, emulous; (Sāy.) = कम्पमान, कम्पमा-
नावयव; (उस्), m. an epithet of Arjuna.

बिभ्राण, अस्, आ, अम् (Pres. part. A.), bearing,
carrying.
